stem: At an entertainment centre, the cost for using a particular video game is \$0.40 per minute. The number of minutes for which people use the video game has mean 15 and variance 9.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the mean and variance of the amount people pay for using the video game.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Each day, 35 people independently use the video game.
parts.text: Find the mean and variance of the total amount paid by 35 people.
